objective: Bind the executed Q_e(W,t)=t A(W) source to the stored M0 heat moments; recover SI endpoint power and cumulative heat; derive an explicit fixed-bath thermal relevance scale and energy-budget envelope.

selected_scenario.source_history: Q_e(W,t)=t A(W) on [0,T], zero initial nonthermal population
selected_scenario.bath: fixed composition and density; inherited fullBED/CCC operator
selected_scenario.source_amplitude_authority: executed physical_energy_scale_eV_m3=T^2*A_E, not a terminal FS10 heat packet

notation.A_E: integral W*A(W)dW over the selected birth window, eV m^-3 s^-2
notation.H0: dimensionless eventual heat fraction for the same normalized source and operator
notation.calorimetric_delta_T: cumulative heat divided by fixed-composition C_V; no coupled temperature history is inferred

claims_to_evaluate: physical source amplitude and selected/birth normalization identity
P(T)=q_star H0 R and E_heat(T)=q_star T H0 S/2
same-source prompt approximation error in absolute SI units
positive energy-only envelope for omitted birth energies, if full source energy is recorded
actual consumer compatibility and remaining selected-observable fields

validation.arithmetic: exact decimal rational or 50-digit Decimal calculations
validation.stored_output_oracle: compare independently computed SI quantities to preserved 9600 paired-run outputs, tolerance 1e-12 relative for reused heating values
validation.independent_decision: reviewer not involved in candidate generation or validation design
validation.coverage: source dimensional identity, zero amplitude, exact birth sum, energy budget, scope of consumer binding

acceptance: A constructive fixed-bath application with source-backed numbers, reproducible derivation/code/results, an independent scoped decision, and a DAG that advances the completed binding while retaining unprovided consumer tolerances as unknown.
source_error_boundary: Arithmetic exactness applies to recorded decimals. Atomic-model, source-window, leading-local approximation, mesh and physical-history errors retain their original evidence limits.

amendments.reason: Consumer source equation includes the particle-number contribution to thermal energy; heat/Cv will be named a calorimetric rate, and same-operator stored secondary ionization events will supply an explicitly incremental local response.
amendments.scope: Additional ionizations caused by degradation of injected secondary electrons; primary proton birth-ionization and complete receiver history remain separate.
